_comment: Why this file exists: some findings cannot be fixed today — a transitive dependency with no
patched release, or an advisory that does not apply to how this app uses the library. Those
need a way to be accepted, and the acceptance needs a reason somebody can argue with.
Why every entry has a review_by: an allowlist entry without an expiry is how a known
vulnerability quietly becomes policy. `scripts/osv_scan.py` FAILS on an entry past its review
date, so an acceptance has to be renewed deliberately rather than inherited.
Fields: id (the OSV/GHSA id) · package · reason (why it does not apply, or why it cannot be
Empty on purpose: as of issue 11.6 the scan reports nothing at or above HIGH.
